name: Faraday Lightning Safety
summary: Created by scientists and students at the Cooperative Institute for Satellite Earth System Studies (CISESS) at the University of Maryland: College Park, Faraday Lightning Safety is an educational game designed to teach audiences of all ages about the Faraday cage effect and its role in lightning safety. Players guide Spark the Owl through various hiding spots, learning which locations offer the best protection and which are the most dangerous during a thunderstorm.
